config.method: learned noisy-channel model of weak-label errors combined with frozen strong-model margin priors, refined via two EM rounds

summary: Combining multi-template margin signals from the frozen strong base model with a learned noisy-channel model of the weak teacher's errors, then refining posterior labels through two rounds of expectation-maximization training, this approach achieved a PGR of 0.78 on the chat preference testbed.
source: Wen, Qiu, et al., 'Automated Weak-to-Strong Researcher', Anthropic Alignment Science Blog, 2026
